dossier_meta.catalog_title: 4-colorability on Fixed Surfaces (Open Step in Thomassen's Program)
dossier_meta.statement_text: Whether 4-colorability of graphs embedded in a fixed surface can be tested in polynomial time remains open; the authors remark that prospects for its resolution in the near future are not very bright.
dossier_meta.context_text: After announcing that Theorem 1.3 completes one of two missing steps in Thomassen's polynomial-time colorability program, the authors identify the remaining open step as the analogous question for 4-coloring graphs on a fixed surface.
